# Verify everything one final time
import subprocess, sys, importlib

import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

# Quick checks
assert semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'major') == '2.0.0'
assert semver.cmd_check('1.2.3') == True
assert semver.cmd_compare('1.2.3', '2.0.0') == -1
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3') == True
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('01.2.3') == False
assert semver.finalize_version('1.2.3-rc.5') == '1.2.3'

r = subprocess.run(['pysemver'], capture_output=True)
assert r.returncode == 2

r = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'bump'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0 and 'usage' in r.stdout.lower()

r = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'check', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.stdout.strip() == 'True'

r = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'check', 'bad'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.stdout.strip() == 'False'

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
